This ship would be the British Kil class patrol gunboat HMS Kildangan. The Razzle Dazzle camouflage was used mostly in WW1 but also a bit in WW2. Unlike other forms of camouflage, the intention of dazzle is not to conceal but to make it difficult to estimate a target's range, speed, and heading and therefore cause the enemy to miss their shot when firing at it.

Note that both bow and stern ends of the ship look the same to further confuse observers.

Jeff Koons designed a modern yacht with a Razzle Dazzle inspired pattern a few years ago.
